infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Voxa may use the microphone if you enable optional audio features in a future update. Spoken replies do not require microphone access.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Voxa uses the camera to capture photos and videos in chat.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Voxa uses your photo library to share images and videos in chat.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Voxa uses your location to provide accurate weather, local suggestions and morning briefings. You can also choose a city manually.
